summary: LiqTech International filed an 8-K reporting a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 20M shares at $1.00/share, raising ~$18M net proceeds via an underwriting agreement with Konik Capital Partners. The proceeds will repay $4.1M in senior and discount promissory notes, with remaining funds for working capital. The underwriter received a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 3M additional shares. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no acquisition, tender, or strategic review is involved. The filing is an ordinary equity financing under an effective S-1 shelf registration.
